# nemau_kubeconfig (Data Source)

A managed cluster's kubeconfig, for chaining into the Kubernetes or Helm provider.

The result is stored in Terraform state in clear text and grants cluster-admin rights; the platform audits each read (`GET_KUBECONFIG`). Encrypt your state, or fetch the kubeconfig outside Terraform with `nemau k8s cluster kubeconfig`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The kubeconfig grants cluster-admin rights and is stored in the state in
# clear text. Keep the state encrypted.
data "nemau_kubeconfig" "prod" {
  cluster_name = nemau_kubernetes_cluster.prod.name
}

output "kubeconfig" {
  value     = data.nemau_kubeconfig.prod.raw
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the cluster: `nemau_kubernetes_cluster.<name>.name`.

### Read-Only

- `raw` (String, Sensitive) The kubeconfig's YAML content.
